A certain club has 12 members, including Harry. One of the 11 members is to be chosen at random to be the president, one of the remaining 10 members is to be chosen at random to be the secretary, and one of the remaining 9 members is to be chosen at random to be the treasurer. What is the probability that Harry will either be the secretary or the member chosen to be the treasurer?

A
2
B
1
C
1/6
✓ Correct
D
3/6
View Explanation & Provenance (Answer: Option C)

Each member out of 12, including Harry, has equal chances to be selected for any of the positions (the sequence of the selection is given just to confuse us). The probability that Harry will be selected to be the secretary is 1/12 and the probability that Harry will be selected to be the treasurer is also 1/12. So, the probability that Harry will be selected to be either the secretary or the the treasurer is 1/12+1/12=2/12. Answer: C.
